Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the recap. A few clarifications:

- Compliance: We must ensure all customer data (including logs and backups) stays within EU borders. Cross-region failover that moves data outside EU is not acceptable unless contractually restricted.
- Preferred option: Private VPC/on-prem is our preferred path if timeline and cost allow. Dedicated capacity with contractual residency guarantees is acceptable if Private is too slow/expensive.
- Traffic: Initial pilot ~5 qps, peaking to ~50 qps in production; average request ~600 tokens. P95 latency target ~250ms for user-facing flows.
- We also need to understand whether your hosted EU region supports strict EU-only routing (no cross-region routing for certain customers) and whether you offer KMS integrations with our keys.

Can Marissa share technical notes on the Private install timeline and what infra footprint (~GPUs) we'd need for 50 qps? Also please include ballpark pricing in EUR for Dedicated vs Private.

Regards,
Thomas

Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency - follow-up

Hi Thomas - thanks, these numbers help.

Short answers:
- Hosted (EU region): We have EU-hosted API endpoints and can configure account-level EU-only routing. However, for customers with legal requirements preventing any cross-border processing of logs/backups, we recommend Dedicated (with contractual residency) or Private VPC/on-prem. Hosted may still involve multi-region backups by default unless we add contractual constraints.
- Dedicated: Provides reserved GPU pools in EU regions and can be contracted to keep all data in EU. Typical entry-level Dedicated commitments for production start in the ballpark of 40k-60k/month depending on capacity and SLOs.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Full control over networking and keys (KMS/HSM) and can be air-gapped if needed. Deployment timeline for an initial pilot typically 4-8 weeks (depends on infra procurement). Total cost = platform license + infra + support; typical enterprise pilots start around 120k upfront + ongoing ops costs - we'll refine after SE sizing.

Attached: a short spreadsheet with initial sizing assumptions for ~50 qps and estimated GPU counts (very rough). Also attaching our residency FAQ.

Marissa - can you confirm the estimated GPU footprint and a rough pilot timeline? Lauren - any contract-side items we should highlight for EU-only residency language (for Thomas to review)?

Proposed next step: Technical deep-dive with Marissa (60 min) - are you available Tue 2026-09-07 10:00 CET? I'll prepare a one-pager comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private with ballpark EUR costs.

Thanks,
Aditya
